_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'hollin_pass' (Hollin Pass). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

tollkeeper_brann.name: Tollkeeper Brann
tollkeeper_brann.greeting: Toll's a copper. For the road, not for me. Mostly not for me.

goatherd_isolde.name: Isolde the goatherd
goatherd_isolde.greeting: Mind the goats. They don't mind you.

fort_sergeant.name: Sergeant Kettle
fort_sergeant.greeting: The fort guards the pass. The pass guards the fort. Nobody guards the sergeant.

climber_cadoc.name: Cadoc the climber
climber_cadoc.greeting: I climb things. Mostly to get away from other things.

angler_hollin_toll.name: Greta Icewell
angler_hollin_toll.greeting: Cut a hole, drop a line, do not fall in. That is the whole craft up here. See the ripples, just north of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

carter_hollin_toll.name: Tibbot Eastmere
carter_hollin_toll.greeting: Walking is free. Riding is nearly free, and you arrive with your legs.

carter_scree_end.name: Jory Furlong
carter_scree_end.greeting: Climb up. Mind the turnips. A few coins and you are in another town before your boots notice.

carter_wolditford.name: Gervase Eastmere
carter_wolditford.greeting: The ox is called Thunder. It is a joke. Where are we going?

quests.name: Snow in the Pass
quests.offer: Frost stalkers came down early. They've been taking travellers at the switchbacks. I can't take a toll off a dead man. Well, I can, but it's rude.

steps.text: Kill 6 frost stalkers at the switchbacks

quests.done: The pass is open. The tolls are flowing. Everyone is happy except the stalkers.

quests.name: Hyenas and Goats
quests.offer: Crag hyenas laugh at my goats. Then they eat my goats. I'd rather they just laughed.

steps.where: the high pastures above Scree End

quests.done: The goats are safe. They don't thank you; they're goats.

quests.name: Beetles on the Road
quests.offer: Ironback beetles keep rolling rocks onto the road. On purpose. I think. I hope not on purpose.

steps.where: the toll road below Hollin Toll Fort
steps.text: Kill 5 ironback beetles on the road

quests.done: Road's clear. If they were doing it on purpose, they'll stop now.

quests.name: The Other Toll
quests.offer: There's a second toll further up. Unofficial. Brigands. They charge more than me, which is the real crime.

steps.where: the upper pass, past Hollin Toll
steps.text: Kill 6 brigands at the false toll

steps.where: the cliffs above the upper pass
steps.text: Kill 3 brigand archers on the cliffs

quests.done: One toll on Hollin Pass, as it should be. Mine.

quests.name: The Old Tower
quests.offer: There's a tower up on the shoulder of the pass, older than the fort. Something keeps a lamp lit at the top. Climb it.

steps.text: Reach the middle floors of the Windlass Spire
steps.where: The Windlass Spire, the dungeon door in Hollin Pass

steps.text: Reach the top of the Windlass Spire
steps.where: the top of the Windlass Spire

quests.done: So that's what was up there. I'll stick to climbing rocks.

quests.name: The Pass's Old Terror
quests.offer: There's a beast up the pass the goats won't go near. Goats go near everything.

steps.where: roams the high pass of Hollin Pass

quests.done: The goats are going near it now. Mostly to sniff it.
